description: Create an alert: a query (source events, errors or sql; measure count or unique_users; filters; an optional groupBy; a window in minutes), a condition (above or below a threshold, or changed by a percent against the window before, a week earlier or the trailing week) and who hears it (recipients among members, saved channels, the team by default). Each series is judged on its own and a series that fired stays quiet for one window. Examples: new issues = source errors, lifecycle first_seen, condition above, threshold 0. Users affected = source errors, measure unique_users, windowMinutes 60, above 100. Signups dropped = source events, event signup, condition changed, changeDirection down, changePercent 50, compare week. Orders stopped = source events, event order_placed, below 1. You cannot name a webhook, a URL or an outside address: a person adds those in Vinktar. Only create an alert when the user asked for one.

changePercent.description: changed: how far it has to move, in percent. Default 50.

channels.description: Where it posts: saved channel ids from get_alert, or a Slack channel of the connected Slack as "#name".

compare.description: changed: against the window before (default), the same window a week earlier, or the trailing week's average.

condition.description: above (default) or below a threshold, or changed by a percent against an earlier window.

environment.description: errors: only this environment, e.g. "production". Omit for all.

event.description: events: the event name, from get_schema; omit for every event.

eventFilters.description: events: {combinator: "AND", filters: [{property: {scope: "event"|"person", key}, op, values: [...]}]}, as a panel series carries them.

everyMinutes.description: How often it is checked. Default 5, or 1 for a lifecycle alert.

floor.description: changed: a change where both sides are under this is not news, so a quiet series going from 1 to 4 stays quiet.

groupBy.description: events, sql: a property to split by; each value is judged on its own (up to 20).

lifecycle.description: errors: read the issues first_seen or regressed since the last check instead of their volume; pair with condition above 0.

links.description: Links shown with every message, e.g. the team's runbook page: a label and an http or https URL each. Replaces the list.

minLevel.description: errors: the least severe level that counts.

name.description: What it alerts on, as a person would say it: "Signups dropping", "New issues in production".

notifyTeam.description: Also tell the owners and admins. Default: on when no recipients or channels are given.

pendingFor.description: Consecutive checks in breach before it fires, so one bad minute is not news. Default 1.

project.description: Project handle (as in list_projects) or id. Optional when this connection is limited to one project or the workspace has only one.

projects.description: Project handles (as in list_projects) or ids, to read across several apps. Leave out for every project this connection can reach. For one project use `project`; never pass both.

recipients.description: Workspace members to email, by address. Outside addresses are refused: a person adds those in Vinktar.

release.description: errors: only issues last seen on this release; a trailing * matches a prefix, e.g. "web@2.*".

source.description: What is read: events (default), errors or sql.

sql.description: sql: VinktarQL whose last column is the value; filter with {from} and {to}.

textContains.description: errors: only issues whose title, type or culprit contains this.

windowMinutes.description: The trailing window in minutes. Default 60.

name: create_alert
title: Create alert
